name: Skiper UI · Pricing

description.zh: 具体条目内容细节展示。 Skiper UI 提供面向 shadcn/ui 的非常规组件集合，首页展示 Image reveal、Hover members、Things drag and scroll、Dynamic island、Vercel Tooltip、Aave token swap 等组件，并给出 npx shadcn add @skiper-ui/skiper40 的安装命令。组件页可按 Free/Pro 筛选并进入各组件详情，定价页列出 Premium 与 Exclusive 方案。
description.en: Skiper UI 提供面向 shadcn/ui 的非常规组件集合，首页展示 Image reveal、Hover members、Things drag and scroll、Dynamic island、Vercel Tooltip、Aave token swap 等组件，并给出 npx shadcn add @skiper-ui/skiper40 的安装命令。组件页可按 Free/Pro 筛选并进入各组件详情，定价页列出 Premium 与 Exclusive 方案。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Skiper UI (https://skiper-ui.com/).
Technology stack: react, shadcn-ui, tailwind, motion.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
